comparison.objective: Mount the final tire-bead section by creating slack in the rim center channel; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests bimanual bead pressing/holding, compliant-shape management, and controlled rolling over a flange. Candidate tests rigid precision-tool insertion, tang release, and wire extraction.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the bead seated, valve aligned, hands off, and no lever intrusion, forced crossing, or tube damage proxy. Candidate requires one terminal out with the housing, crimp, and neighboring contacts intact.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is shared only generically; tire-bead slack management and connector latch release are materially different abilities.
